info.shortName: Xtrackers Low Beta High Yield B
info.longName: Xtrackers Low Beta High Yield Bond ETF

funds_data.description: The fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets, (but typically far more) in component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of the segment of the U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bond market that exhibits lower overall beta to the broader high yield corporate fixed income market.
